name: Bilal Asad Ithnan Faranbald
original_name: ビラール アサド イスナーン ファランバルド
source:
The young prince from the Faranband Kingdom who's studying magic to solve the drought in his homeland. He's quite sociable and his closeness to other people shocks a bit Lulu and her clique at first. However, Bilal is very loyal to his friends.

[Edited from [url=http://wand-of-fortune.wikia.com/wiki/Bilal_Asad_Ithnan_Faranbald]WOF Wikia[/url]]
